ns2:section.sectionText: This course will cover a variety of topics designed to help students learn more about, and be better prepared to enter the media industry as professionals. Course content will include an overview of career opportunities available in the field of advertising, successful strategies for obtaining and building careers in the industry, as well as interactive sessions with media industry professionals. This course will also contain 9 days of field study in San Francisco and Los Angeles, CA. Application is available at http://go.media.illinois.edu/california and is due on 10/12. Course fee is approximately $2,650.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
